tokens.name: space-void
tokens.usage: Page background (body), star-field base and the ink on gold buttons. The darkest step of the space scale.

tokens.name: space-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar panel background, one hair lighter than space-void.

tokens.name: space-deep
tokens.usage: Secondary dark panels (bg-space-deep).

tokens.name: space-navy
tokens.usage: Nebula glow centre at the top of the page; input field base (at 50% alpha).

tokens.name: space-mid
tokens.usage: Focused input background (at 60% alpha) and card-surface gradient start.

tokens.name: space-light
tokens.usage: Lightest navy; occasional chart fills and raised navy accents.

tokens.name: gold-dim
tokens.usage: Deep gold for low-emphasis gilded details.

tokens.name: gold-muted
tokens.usage: Start/end stop of every gold gradient (btn-gold, progress bar, nav indicator).

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the btn-gold gradient.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: THE brand accent: logo ink, ASTRA wordmark, icon badges, stat numbers, focus border, selection text. On space-void ≈ 12:1.

tokens.name: gold-glow
tokens.usage: Highlight stop for text-gradient-gold and the hero second line.

tokens.name: clinical-void
tokens.usage: Page background of the Pre-medicina area.

tokens.name: clinical-deep
tokens.usage: Raised panels in the Pre-medicina area.

tokens.name: clinical-dark
tokens.usage: Start stop of the btn-clinical and clinical-beam gradients.

tokens.name: clinical-teal
tokens.usage: Accent of the Pre-medicina (health sciences) module: buttons, borders, glows.

tokens.name: clinical-light
tokens.usage: Highlight stop for text-gradient-teal.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Semantic page ground. Body text-body, text-strong and accent read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Semantic raised panel ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Semantic accent: gold in the main app, teal in Pre-medicina. Never both on one screen.

tokens.name: accent-start
tokens.usage: First stop of the accent gradient on primary buttons and bars.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent (gold or teal) button. ≥ 10:1 on both accents.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Input text and emphasized body copy on surface-page.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Default body copy on surface-page (≈ 13:1).

tokens.name: text-90
tokens.usage: Active nav item, card titles.

tokens.name: text-72
tokens.usage: Header section title, hovered nav item.

tokens.name: text-50
tokens.usage: Hero subcopy, chip text, secondary copy. ≈ 5:1 on space-void.

tokens.name: text-45
tokens.usage: Field labels, table metadata. ≈ 4.5:1 on space-void — the floor for body-size text.

tokens.name: text-35
tokens.usage: Resting nav links and fine print. ≈ 3.2:1 on space-void: FAILS 4.5:1 for 13px text; kept exact from the source — prefer text-45 for new work.

tokens.name: text-30
tokens.usage: Stat labels, table headers, logout at rest. ≈ 2.8:1: FAILS 4.5:1; kept exact from the source — decorative/meta only.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder. Below 3:1 — never for content.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Structural dividers: sidebar/header borders, table rules.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Glass and input borders at rest.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Glass border on hover.

tokens.name: fill-glass
tokens.usage: Glass card and ghost button fill.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Ghost button and icon button hover fill.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Gold icon-badge and pending-badge fill.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Gold borders (btn-fill, glass-gold hover, gold badges).

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Clinical tinted fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Aprobado, positive change (+8%), scores ≥ 80. Always with a word or sign, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rechazado, negative change, scores < 60, logout hover. Differs from success mostly by hue — always pair with a label.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pendiente and scores 60–79 reuse the brand gold.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Teacher role badge, 'Ver' secondary actions.

tokens.name: info-strong
tokens.usage: Info tint/border base (rgba 0.1/0.2) and blue chart series.

tokens.name: role-admin
tokens.usage: Administrador role badge ink.

tokens.name: role-teacher
tokens.usage: Profesor role badge ink.

tokens.name: role-student
tokens.usage: Alumno role badge ink.

tokens.name: subject-math
tokens.usage: Pensamiento Matemático subject badge (Tailwind blue-300 on blue-500/20).

tokens.name: subject-reading
tokens.usage: Comprensión Lectora subject badge (purple-300).

tokens.name: subject-writing
tokens.usage: Redacción Indirecta subject badge (emerald-300).

tokens.name: subject-premed
tokens.usage: Pre-medicina subject badge (teal-300).

tokens.name: subject-health
tokens.usage: Ciencias de la Salud subject badge (cyan-300).

styles.name: hero

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Pricing figure on the landing page.

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Ellos ya entraron a la universidad.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: StatCard value, set in the gold gradient.

styles.name: wordmark-sub

styles.name: body
